title: ZeroAI
tagline: ZeroAI extends AI adoption by empowering Offline Access to agents created on Filecoin.
description: An easy way to use AI agents offline. ZeroAI indexes datasets stored on Filecoin, creating a secure backend that enables AI agents to respond to user queries sent via SMS. This approach breaks down connectivity barriers, making powerful AI tools available to millions who are typically underserved due to lack of internet access.
how_its_made:
ZeroAI marketplace enables users to publish new or existing content stored on Filecoin for public access.  AI-Agents can vectorize, and embed this data into their knowledge base. Each piece of content is published along with an NFT contract, allowing only NFT holders to securely decrypt and access the content. The signing and encryption are handled by LIT Protocol.

With the help of IPNS, AI agents can upsert additional vectors into the same pointer as their knowledge base grows. The agent also keeps track of CIDs by logging hashes of indexed vectors on a contract deployed on FVM.

Users can interact with an AI agent by sending queries via an authorized phone number. The SMS provider, Twilo, forwards these queries to the backend via a pre-configured webhook. 

For easy access, each AI agent can be represented by an ENS name, which is resolvable on the backend. This means users won’t have to type out full addresses when initiating sessions.

If found in the backend, a matching agent can perform similarity checks between the user's prompt and its knowledge base. 

Finally, a natural language response is returned to the user via SMS.

AI for everyone.
